text:
maria_marketing: Quick ask — we need a punchy one-pager (playbook style) for Secure Deploy that we can hand to AE after the webinar and drop on the site as a download. Target audience: security/compliance leads + infra/platform teams. Needs: high-level deploy modes, SLA callouts, benchmark blurb, 2x sales snippets, and inbound routing tags.
sam_sales: Timeline? Who owns final? Also need a tiny sales-ready 2-line opener and a subject line for follow-ups.
devon_product: I can draft structure. Suggest: 1) What it solves (2 lines) 2) Deploy modes (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) w/ 1-line pros 3) SLA summary (uptime, latency p95 targets) 4) Benchmark highlights (latency, throughput, cost delta) 5) Security callouts (KMS, VPC, audit logs) 6) CTA + routing tags.
tara_field: For AE handoff: include an elevator pitch (30s), objection-handling bullets (data residency, SLAs), and a short tech snippet they can email.
oliver_growth: Messaging test idea: Variant A focuses on "Control & Compliance" and Variant B on "Predictable Performance & Economics". We should include UTM-friendly CTAs and a lead tag like "enterprise-secure-deploy" so marketing routing sends to sales queue.
maria_marketing: Deadline: EOW Friday. Draft owners: devon_product for the first pass, sam_sales will polish for field, oliver_growth will add tracking/CTAs, tara_field will verify AE copy.
maria_marketing: Quick benchmark draft to include (placeholder numbers — replace with final): "P95 latency: 85ms; Throughput: 120 reqs/s on x8 GPUs; Token cost: ~0.6x vs naive serving; Failover: automatic model fallback within 200ms". Put these as a small callout.
devon_product: Cool — here's a micro draft snippet for the one-pager body we can iterate on:

"Redwood Secure Deploy: Enterprise inference with predictable SLAs and private deployment options. Ship features with the same API across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private environments while keeping keys, logs, and controls inside your perimeter."

Bullets:
- Hosted — fast onboarding, public cloud, quick scale
- Dedicated — reserved GPU pools, predictable throughput, SLA-backed latency
- Private — VPC/on-prem with KMS/HSM, audit logs, air-gapped option

SLA summary (callout): 99.9% uptime, P95 latency targets per model class; optional enterprise SLA with 24/7 support.

Benchmark highlight (callout): P95 85ms, 120 reqs/s on tested config, cost optimization via KV caching and batching.

CTA: Download full playbook / Request a dedicated trial (tag: enterprise-secure-deploy)
sam_sales: Nice start. For AE email snippet — two options:
- Short subject: "Secure inference with enterprise SLAs — quick brief"
- 2-line intro: "We recently helped a platform team cut inference costs while meeting strict latency SLAs. Attached is a one-pager outlining deployment options and security controls — happy to connect for a short walkthrough."

tara_field: Add 3 objection responses (ready to paste):
- Data residency: "We support VPC, on-prem and GovCloud variants; keys never leave customer control."
- SLA/uptime: "We offer reserved capacity with SLA and escalation playbooks for incidents."
- Performance: "Our runtime uses KV caching and dynamic batching to meet p95 targets while lowering token cost."
oliver_growth: Routing rules for inbound leads (proposed):
- All downloads / CTA clicks -> add tag: enterprise-secure-deploy
- UTMs: utm_campaign=secure-deploy_webinar, utm_content=onepager
- Send to SFDC queue: "AE_Enterprise_Security" with priority=High
- Auto-email follow-up template id: mk_follow_secure_01

maria_marketing: Checklist for deliverables (code block):
```
- devon_product: draft one-pager (v1)
- sam_sales: field polish and AE snippets
- oliver_growth: tracking tags + CTAs
- tara_field: sales objections + email copy
- marketing: upload asset + create gated download + routing rules
```

sam_sales: I'll take lead on the final copy and do the AE-ready export. Can we get all drafts in the doc by Thu noon? I can finalize Thu afternoon.

launch-bot: Webinar "Enterprise Secure Deploy" scheduled for 2026-04-09 11:00 PT — reminder 3 days before.

devon_product: Thumbs up. I'll drop v1 in the drive by Wed EOD and link here.
tara_field: Once v1 is in I'll craft the 30s pitch and the two email templates.
oliver_growth: I'll set up the UTM & routing in Campaigns and flag mk_follow_secure_01 for the ops team.
maria_marketing: Thanks everyone — syncing quick on Thu 10:30 to close the copy and confirm routing. :thumbsup:
